heroHeadline: SAF Drone Strikes on Nyala Enter Third Day — Hemedti Reportedly in City; WFP: 19.5M Acutely Food Insecure with Lean Season Approaching
heroSubtitle: On Day 1128, SAF conducted drone strikes on Nyala, South Darfur, for a third consecutive day — targeting RSF weapons depots in the Al-Masane district as intelligence indicates Hemedti is present in the city. The strikes continue a sustained Darfur aerial campaign that has hit all five RSF-held state capitals in May 2026 (Nyala, Al-Daein, El Geneina, Al Zorg, and Kabkabiya). A WFP/FAO/UNICEF joint report published mid-May documented 19.5 million Sudanese facing acute food insecurity, with 5 million at emergency levels and 135,000 in famine conditions — the worst lean season since the war began expected June–August 2026, with the UN appeal still only ~20% funded. Washington Post investigations and OHCHR data confirm drone strikes killed 880+ civilians in January–April 2026 alone — over 80% of all conflict casualties. SAF's 4th Infantry Division recaptured Khor Hassan in Blue Nile State (May 16), continuing the rollback of RSF-SPLM-N forces toward Kurmuk. Sudan's civil war has entered its 38th month with SAF pressing multi-front military advances in Kordofan, Blue Nile, and Darfur while diplomatic efforts — ICG's Quad truce push, the US House RSF genocide resolution (44–2 vote), and Burhan's Gulf tour — have yet to produce a ceasefire framework.
